name: MKT_IMP_CALL_LST_CON_T
description: The Import Interface table to populate MKT_CALL_LST_CON: This table stores references to the customers  targetted when the list is used during a campaign launch process. A marketing  list will typically have many list contacts (members).

columns.name: IMPORT_JOB_ID
columns.description: Import Job Identifier, no longer part of Primary Key

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Primary Key - Batch Identifier that groups data into a batch

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Primary Key - Interface Row ID. Used to link this record with the error record.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status flag - similar to IMPORT_STATUS_CODE

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action Code to indicate Insert or Update action

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CALL_LST_CON_T_ID
columns.description: Alternate Key. Interface Row Id. Will be used to link this row with rows in the error table.

columns.name: CALL_LST_CON_ID
columns.description: Call list contact id. Fusion Primary key.

columns.name: CALL_LST_ID
columns.description: Call List Identifier to the Call List table

columns.name: CON_PER_ID
columns.description: Contact Person Identifier to the Person table

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_ID
columns.description: TCA Relationship Identifier of the call list for this record

columns.name: VALID_FLAG
columns.description: Valid Flag indicates call list validity for this record

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Call List Error Message for this record

columns.name: PARTY_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Party Original System. Stores a unique identifier for the party in the source system. Used to lookup CON_PER_ID.

columns.name: PARTY_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Party Original System Reference. Stores a unique identifier for the party reference in the source system. Used to lookup CON_PER_ID.

columns.name: ORG_PARTY_ORIG_SYS
columns.description: Org Party Original System. Stores a unique identifier for the Organization party in the source system. Used to lookup ORG_PARTY_ID.

columns.name: ORG_PARTY_ORIG_SYS_REF
columns.description: Org Party Original System Reference. Stores a unique identifier for the Organization party in the source system. Used to lookup ORG_PARTY_ID.

columns.name: ORG_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Org Party Identifier. Stores a unique identifier for the Organization party in the source system. Used as OBJECT_ID to lookup RELATIONSHIP_ID from HZ_ORIG_SYS_REFERENCES.

columns.name: LIST_EXT_REF
columns.description: List External Reference. Stores a unique identifier of the list/segment proxy in the source system. Used to lookup CALL_LST_ID.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: File record indicator in the file.
